basis: 1860 census, Southern District, Loudoun, p. 130: Joseph R Janney, 18, in the household of Asa M Janney, 39, with Mary, 35 (data/census_pilot.csv, the owner's pilot). The son lies at Lakeview, the parents at Harmony.
note: Joseph R. Janney enlisted in Company A, 8th Virginia (the Hillsboro Border Guards), and lost a limb at First Manassas on 21 July 1861, aged 18. He was later a jeweller in Purcellville. Richmond Virginian, 28 March 1911, p. 2.
